expectedIssues: Promo banner text is unreadable, white text on a pale mint background
reportedIssues: The green promo banner uses white text ('3 free deliveries for you' and the code/min-order line) on a very light mint background, giving very low contrast and making the offer details hard to read.

The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' is hard-clipped by the viewport edge — the name reads 'Trattoria Piccol' and the delivery price is cut mid-line, with no visible affordance that the row scrolls.

Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the Tokumaru Ramen card has a white circular button while the pizza card below has a dark/transparent circular button, so the same control looks like two different states.
The category filter chip row is cut off at the right edge with only a sliver of the next chip visible, which reads as a rendering glitch rather than a scrollable list.
The second 'Popular right now' card is cut off by the fixed bottom navigation bar with no bottom spacing, so its title/metadata are hidden behind the nav.
Restaurant card images appear as heavily blurred/generic illustrations with strong vignettes, making dishes hard to identify and looking like low-quality placeholders.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 0 describes the same white promo-banner text on a pale mint background with insufficient contrast.
